title: iGEM 2018 Interlab Study Protocol: Calibration 2
author: Ylenia Longo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qn6dvhe
materials: Continue this procedure until arrived at well A

steps.title: Prepare microsphere stock solution
steps.instruction: Vortex the "Silica beads" tube from the Interlab Measurement kit vigorously for 30 seconds; immediately pipet 96 µl of microspheres into a 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube; add 904 µl ddH₂O; vortex the tube well to obtain the microsphere stock solution.

steps.title: Add water to assay wells
steps.instruction: Pipet 100 µl ddH₂O into wells A2‑A12, then repeat the same for rows B, C and D (wells B2‑B12, C2‑C12, D2‑D12).

steps.title: Add stock to first column
steps.instruction: Pipet 200 µl of the microsphere stock solution into wells A1, B1, C1 and D1.

steps.title: Perform serial dilutions
steps.instruction: For each row (A, B, C, D): transfer 100 µl of microsphere stock from the first well to the next well, mix 3× by pipetting up and down; repeat the transfer‑mix cycle from well 2 to 3, 3 to 4, … until well 11; after mixing well 11, transfer the final 100 µl to liquid waste (do not add to well 12).

steps.title: Re‑mix rows before reading
steps.instruction: Before measuring, mix each row again (pipette up and down) because silica particles settle and can affect results.

steps.title: Measure absorbance at 600 nm
steps.instruction: Measure the absorbance of all samples at 600 nm, using the same measurement mode that will be used for the cell measurements.

steps.title: Import data into Excel
steps.instruction: Import the recorded absorbance values into the iGEM‑provided Excel sheet (particle standard curve tab).
